objective: Close a formal-evidence integrity gap in the raw native-4K temporal sequences used to judge severe aliasing/shimmer and visible LOD pop, without awarding any visual points before real Unity-rendered pixels exist.

investigation.selectedIssue: Raw QATemporal_subpixel_grazing_*_MSAA and QATemporal_lod_walk_oblique_*_MSAA frames are authoritative evidence for the Temporal/LOD/Aliasing category and two critical automatic-fail defects. Existing display-transfer QA covers QATemporal_, while the detailed camera lifecycle purity guard is scoped to QA4K_ and QAPreparedTemporal_. This left no dedicated pre-cull -> pre-render -> post-render equality proof for raw temporal camera/target state or the complete physical-lighting/renderable/material/GI/reflection fingerprint.
investigation.risk: A callback could change camera pose/FOV, target state, sun/sky, render policy, renderer/material/texture state, GI binding or reflection-probe state inside a raw temporal frame. The resulting PNG could remain sealed and look plausible while no longer being a trustworthy basis for shimmer/LOD-pop scoring.
investigation.scopeDecision: Add a dedicated read-only raw-temporal lifecycle guard rather than broadening the still/prepared-temporal camera guard. Raw temporal capture intentionally permits the supported 1/2/4/8 MSAA sample counts and has a distinct capture/sealing path, so a separate contract makes those semantics explicit and avoids conflating still evidence with motion evidence.

changes.summary: Added a machine-readable zero-point contract covering the two approved raw temporal target families, native 3840x2160 ARGB32/sRGB/non-mipmapped output, supported 1/2/4/8 samples, read-only lifecycle equality, physical-lighting/renderable/material/GI/reflection fingerprint equality and explicit failure injections.

Added an InitializeOnLoad fail-closed guard for approved QATemporal targets. At pre-cull it validates the established camera/light contracts and records SHA-256 fingerprints for camera/target state plus the repository's complete physical-lighting/renderable/material/GI/reflection state. Pre-render and post-render must reproduce both fingerprints exactly or the frame is rejected; lifecycle state is always cleared after post-render.

formalEvidenceBehavior.preCull: Read-only validation; establishes the accepted camera/target SHA-256 and complete physical-state SHA-256.
formalEvidenceBehavior.preRender: Read-only validation; both fingerprints must exactly match pre-cull before rendering proceeds.
formalEvidenceBehavior.postRender: Read-only validation; both fingerprints must exactly match pre-cull before the raw temporal frame can proceed to resolve/readback/sealing.
formalEvidenceBehavior.msaaPolicy: Accepts only supported raw temporal sample counts 1, 2, 4 or 8; no false assumption that every platform must produce 4x MSAA.
formalEvidenceBehavior.visualScoring: No automatic points. Actual sealed 3840x2160 temporal sequences and 100% crops still require real Unity rendering and pixel review before Temporal/LOD/Aliasing can receive observed-evidence credit.

failureInjection: Change MainCamera transform/FOV/clip/culling/viewport between pre-cull and pre-render
Attach a camera command buffer or second enabled OnRenderImage effect
Change SummerSun direction/color/intensity/shadow state or sky/ambient/global render policy mid-frame
Change a renderable mesh/material/texture/MaterialPropertyBlock or GI/lightmap/reflection-probe binding mid-frame
Begin a nested/stale lifecycle on the same raw temporal RenderTexture

verification.repositoryDiff: 2 substantive files added before this run record; UnityProject/Assets/Editor and UnityProject/Assets/QA only; no Godot path was touched.
verification.sourceReview: The committed QA source was re-read from the branch after commit. Target-name recognition is limited to the two canonical QATemporal probe families with two-digit frame suffixes. The guard reuses existing CameraEvidence and LightEvidence source validation and the v6 complete physical-lighting fingerprint instead of inventing a weaker parallel lighting model.

implementationReadiness.reason: Raw temporal evidence now has a dedicated fail-closed intra-frame state-integrity gate, but Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime, failure-injection execution and real native-4K temporal pixels are still unavailable.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.note: These are expected evidence-quality impacts only, not Visual Fidelity points.
